reference.text: A dead job sits in queue.dead (docs/lifecycle.md:9 `**dead**`).
It is never run again (docs/lifecycle.md:9 `never run again`).

reference.text: LRUCache keeps entries in recency order, the most recently used last (src/cache.py:11 `self._items = OrderedDict()`).
put evicts the entry at the front once the capacity is exceeded (src/cache.py:30 `self._items.popitem(last=False)`).
A ttl also makes get drop expired entries (src/cache.py:19 `self.ttl is not None`).
JobQueue orders jobs by ready_at first (src/jobq.py:31 `heapq.heappush(self._heap, (ready_at,`).
Ties go to the lower priority number (src/jobq.py:30 `priority (lower first)`).
Then the order they were pushed in decides, as push order (src/jobq.py:30 `then push order`).
pop removes the next job once it is due (src/jobq.py:34 `Return the next job whose ready_at has passed`).
It never evicts: a job that keeps failing goes to the dead list (src/jobq.py:43 `self.dead.append(job)`).

reference.text: - A job is always in one of five states (docs/lifecycle.md:3 `A job is always in one of five states.`).
- A handler that raises sends the job back with a backoff delay (docs/lifecycle.md:8 `back in the queue with a backoff delay`).
- A job is dead after the third retry or when no handler is registered (docs/lifecycle.md:9 `or no handler is registered`).
- Dead jobs are never run again (docs/lifecycle.md:9 `never run again`).
- Dead jobs live in memory only, so a restart drops them (docs/lifecycle.md:13 `Dead jobs are kept in memory only.`).

reference.text: - run starts run_forever on a fresh queue (src/cli.py:34 `run_forever(queue, settings)`).
- enqueue pushes one job onto a fresh queue (src/cli.py:31 `queue.push(Job(args.name, json.loads(args.payload)))`).
- handlers lists the registered names (src/cli.py:27 `print("\n".join(sorted(HANDLERS)))`).
- The jobq command takes a --config option for a settings file (src/cli.py:13 `parser.add_argument("--config"`).
- A job queued this way lives in this process only and is not saved (src/cli.py:1 `queues one job in this process only`).
- Retries are limited to at most 3 (docs/limits.md:3 `Retries: at most 3`).
- The queue is in memory, so nothing survives a restart (docs/limits.md:4 `The queue is in memory.`).
- The default is 2 workers (docs/limits.md:5 `Workers: the default is 2`).
- The log level is info by default (docs/limits.md:6 `Log level`).
- There is no authentication, so run it only on a trusted host (docs/limits.md:7 `There is no authentication.`).
